title: Aravind Srinivas - Building An Answer Engine - [Invest Like the Best, EP.363]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Aravind Srinivas.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Aravind Srinivas. He is the founder and CEO of Perplexity, a startup that he describes as an “answer engine” built from scratch with AI. Aravind has set out for perplexity to become the most powerful answer engine backed by up-to-date sources.

key_points.text: He helps me pick the technology apart.
Our conversation goes deep into programming this type of infrastructure, the competition around latency, and constructing a business model around deep learning.
There is so much on this horizon, so please enjoy my conversation with Aravind Srinivas.
